initial_assertion.statement: Multiplication by n=2^a on an elliptic curve over characteristic-zero F is surjective on E(Fsep), with finite kernel E[n], and its point groups are discrete continuous G_F modules.
initial_assertion.objects: Elliptic curve E over characteristic-zero F, n=2^a, continuous Galois cohomology and actual Heegner fields where indicated.
initial_assertion.hypotheses: Silverman III.4 pp66–68: nonconstant multiplication is a finite surjective isogeny; Fsep algebraically closed.
initial_assertion.quantifiers: Every specified field, curve and exponent a>=1 satisfying the stated hypotheses.
initial_assertion.parameter_range: Characteristic zero, including local residue characteristic2; actual permitted finite Heegner stages.
initial_assertion.uniformity: Functorial algebraic assertion; no quantitative field or conductor bound.
initial_assertion.constants: n=2^a; c_E only when supplied by the separate local cohomology bound.
initial_assertion.normalizations: Additive cocycles gQ-Q and ordinary multiplication; no division by field degree or coefficient-group n.
initial_assertion.exceptional_cases: No good reduction, finite Sha, rank, rational torsion or arbitrary unproved local bound is assumed; ring-class and local-model premises remain separate.
initial_assertion.limit_order: Fix F,E,a; obtain the multiplication exact sequence before constructing cocycles.
